tests.applicability: Same-origin equal-generation stale edit is rejected; saved owner draft remains and stale tab cannot checkpoint.

tests.name: coalesced typing restores to its unchanged React value without reviving the deleted draft
tests.applicability: Exercises delayed journal restore/deletion and editor-value reconciliation; does not simulate process exit.

tests.name: writing UI recovers multi-document drafts and separates Draft, Checkpoint, and GitHub publication
tests.applicability: Exercises completed draft recovery/reload, checkpointing, and publication receipts on a disposable local fixture.

tests.name: IndexedDB quota failures remain visible and block checkpointing
tests.applicability: Monkeypatches IDB put to throw QuotaExceededError; verifies visible warning, disabled checkpoint, and beforeunload confirmation on reload. Not actual quota exhaustion.

dispositions.rationale: The focused cohort separates a short scene-view API route from longer end-to-end readiness/render waits but cannot attribute the remaining wait to a safe producer seam or establish a before/after gain.
Each burst used one completed strict write; measured transaction duration does not justify weakening strict durability or reducing completed writes. Queue wait is only an inferred, uncontended proxy.

The W1 local merge remains active and no full entries/proposals refresh appeared in the autosave windows. Historical W1 read reduction remains 74 to 31 with the recorded typing and Long Task tradeoff; this run is not an independent A/B.
No contended queue wait or safe parallel alternative was demonstrated. Preserve serialized generation checks and flush ordering.
Draft, Checkpoint, and confirmed publication remain distinct invariants; prior browser regression coverage passed and no stage change is proposed.

No stronger page-exit durability claim or async write optimization is proposed. Existing quota visibility/reload regression passed; pagehide/force-quit/process-kill/OS-termination/power-loss durability remain NOT_CHECKED.

limits: Three autosave samples and eight clean navigation samples are one small-fixture Chromium capture; p95 is the maximum at n=8.
Timer-to-transaction-start is an inferred queue wait proxy, not direct draftQueueRef instrumentation.
Strict IndexedDB transaction duration is browser-observed completion, not a physical fsync count or device flush cost.
Rapid navigation injects no delayed/reordered response.
No new C14-C16 journal occupancy/inventory measurement was run.
No production source, schema, queue, authority, or test source was changed.
notChecked: Successful asynchronous pagehide or beforeunload manuscript write completion.
Actual browser storage exhaustion beyond the existing synthetic exception test.
Native force-quit, browser-process kill, OS termination, and power-loss recovery.
